caption:
"Say: O My servants who have believed, fear your Lord." The patient will be given their reward without account.

Surah Az-Zumar (39:10). Swipe through for the Arabic, then English, Mandarin, Korean, Japanese, Malay, Thai and Spanish.

Sources on the final slide.

sourcing.primary_text: Qur'an 39:10, Surah Az-Zumar. Not used by any prior blankdiscussions post (checked against all existing meta.json slugs; 39:53 is a different verse). Standing 8-language/10-slide format.
sourcing.arabic: Edition quran-uthmani, live call https://api.alquran.cloud/v1/ayah/39:10/editions/quran-uthmani,en.sahih,zh.jian,ko.korean,ja.japanese,ms.basmeih,th.thai,es.cortes (HTTP 200, fetched 2026-10-16); fetched twice in the same script and the two responses diffed byte-identical; slide text written programmatically from the raw API fields, no retyping.
sourcing.other_editions: en.sahih (Saheeh International), zh.jian (Ma Jian), ms.basmeih (Abdullah Muhammad Basmeih), th.thai (King Fahad Quran Complex), es.cortes (Julio Cortes): same call, byte-identical. ko.korean and ja.japanese: translator listed as unknown by source; slide says 'Translator not specified by source'.
sourcing.source_artifact_note: Artifact scan (double spaces, space before punctuation, leading/trailing whitespace, control chars) found none in any edition. Slide text byte-identical to the API. Source-side spacing quirks in the Korean edition (e.g. '나 의', '하 는' style word splits) and Spanish edition spelling 'recibierán' are reproduced as-is, not edited.
sourcing.verification_note: Live fetch performed this session (2026-10-16) in the same script that wrote the slide files; two fetches diffed identical. No wording from memory.
sourcing.compliance_check: Checked manually against 83 string terms flattened from compliance-policy.json halal.prohibited across all edition text (word-boundary match): 0 hits.
